entities.summary: Haitian, a notable figure in the history of Dominican Republic, associated with Haitian Occupation and Dominican Independence (1822–1844). Preceded by Abolition of slavery in eastern Hispaniola by Haitian decree and Jean-Pierre Boyer unifies Hispaniola under Haitian rule 1822. Their legacy influenced Dominican independence declared — February 27, 1844 and Duarte founds La Trinitaria secret society 1838.
